name: CREATE PURCHASE ORDER - MISSING LINE ITEM IS BLOCKED
objective: Verify that SAP refuses to create a purchase order when the header has a supplier but the document has no line item.
preconditions: The run owner has approved the named non-production dataset and the SAP target is live-verified as non-production. Any draft state is retained unchanged for compliance review.
learningObjectives: After this section you can verify SAP purchase-order completeness validation.
After this section you can distinguish an expected business-validation pass from an execution or network failure.
After this section you can trace the negative attempt to its owner-linked automation reference.
commonErrorsAndTips: A changed document title means SAP may have created a purchase order unexpectedly. The test fails and stops immediately; investigate the retained state without automatic reversal.
An unchanged title without an expected SAP validation message is not a pass. It can indicate a network or UI synchronization failure.
Run this case only against a live-verified non-production target with approved test-data ownership.

params.expectedMessages: ["At least one item","Enter at least one item","No items exist","Document contains no items","Document is incomplete","Purchase order is incomplete"]
